name: Finance
description: Retail banking core: branches, customers (CIF), deposit accounts, transactions, cards, lending, credit risk and AML.
descriptionJa: リテールバンキングの基幹システム。拠点・顧客(CIF)・預金口座・取引・カード・融資・与信リスク・マネロン対策を含む。

tableDescriptions.BRN_BRANCHES: Branch master: the twelve branches, their region, address and opening date. BR012 is the online-only branch.
tableDescriptions.BRN_EMPLOYEES: Bank staff assigned to a branch, with role and hire date. Loan officers are referenced from LON_LOANS.
tableDescriptions.BRN_ATMS: ATMs belonging to a branch, with cash on hand, service state and last service date.
tableDescriptions.CIF_CUSTOMERS: Customer Information File: 120 individuals and corporates with segment, risk rating, income and home branch. The hub the rest of the schema hangs off.
tableDescriptions.CIF_ADDRESSES: Customer addresses by type (home, work, registered), with the primary one flagged.
tableDescriptions.CIF_KYC_CHECKS: Know-your-customer checks: document type, result and expiry. Higher-risk customers also carry an enhanced due diligence record.
tableDescriptions.CIF_RELATIONSHIPS: Links between customers: spouse, parent, guarantor, group company.
tableDescriptions.ACC_PRODUCTS: Deposit product catalogue: savings, checking, time deposits and foreign currency, with base rate and fees.
tableDescriptions.ACC_INTEREST_RATES: Interest rates applied to a deposit product over a validity period.
tableDescriptions.ACC_ACCOUNTS: Deposit accounts: balance, available balance, holds and overdraft limit, tied to a customer, product and branch.
tableDescriptions.ACC_BALANCE_HISTORY: Daily closing balances per account, with debit and credit totals. Unique on (ACCOUNT_ID, AS_OF_DATE).
tableDescriptions.CRD_MERCHANTS: Merchant master for card acceptance, with category and MCC.
tableDescriptions.CRD_CARDS: Debit and credit cards issued to a customer against an account, with limit, available credit and status.
tableDescriptions.TXN_TRANSACTIONS: Account transaction ledger: deposits, withdrawals, transfers, card payments, fees and interest, with the channel and running balance.
tableDescriptions.TXN_TRANSFERS: Outgoing transfers to other banks, with beneficiary, fee, status and failure reason.
tableDescriptions.TXN_STANDING_ORDERS: Recurring debits set up on an account: payee, amount, frequency and next run date.
tableDescriptions.CRD_AUTHORIZATIONS: Card authorisation attempts: amount, merchant, approve/decline and whether it settled.
tableDescriptions.LON_PRODUCTS: Lending product catalogue: mortgage, auto, education, personal and business, with amount and term ranges.
tableDescriptions.LON_LOANS: Loan contracts: principal, outstanding balance, rate, term, monthly payment and days delinquent.
tableDescriptions.LON_REPAYMENTS: Repayment schedule and actuals per instalment. Unique on (LOAN_ID, INSTALLMENT_NO).
tableDescriptions.LON_COLLATERALS: Collateral pledged against a loan, with appraised value and loan-to-value ratio.
tableDescriptions.RSK_CREDIT_SCORES: Credit scores per customer, with the model used, rating band and probability of default.
tableDescriptions.RSK_EXPOSURES: Credit exposure per customer by type, against the approved limit, with utilisation.
tableDescriptions.AML_ALERTS: Anti-money-laundering alerts raised by rule, linked to the customer and the triggering transaction.
tableDescriptions.AML_WATCHLIST: Sanctions and watch lists screened against. Dummy entries only; no real individuals or entities.
